title: Generic REST Connection
description: Connect any agent that exposes a plain REST API and a health-check endpoint.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: The root URL your agent's REST API is reachable at.

authMethod.title: Authentication Method
authMethod.description: How AMS authenticates to your agent's API.

healthCheckEndpoint.title: Health Check Endpoint
healthCheckEndpoint.description: A relative path (e.g. /health) AMS can call to confirm the agent is reachable.

telemetryWebhookUrl.title: Telemetry Webhook URL
telemetryWebhookUrl.description: Where AMS should deliver telemetry events for this agent.

customHeaders.title: Custom Headers
customHeaders.description: Optional additional headers AMS should send with every request to this agent.
